hints.title: Uniform Multiplier Formulation
hints.text: Providing uniform capacity C across all items requires total budget C * sum(costs).

hints.title: Integer Division
hints.text: The maximum uniform capacity is floor(budget / sum(costs)).

hints.title: Handle Zero Sum Edge Case
hints.text: If sum(costs) == 0, capacity is effectively infinite.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating incremental capacity additions takes O(budget) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects direct algebraic solution budget // sum(costs).
